name: lattice.asset-classify
description: Classify one proposed or existing RIG asset (a Recall build card, a skill, an agent, a harness, a loop, a hook or a workflow) onto the real RIG lattice axes: asset kind, BMS archetype family (A1-A4), altitude level (L1-L7) and diamond plane (D1-D3), plus whether it is buildable now. Advisory until calibrated - it classifies, it does not gate.

asset_kind.instructions: Which RIG asset kind does this card actually specify? Judge by what the card asks to exist, not by the domain it talks about.

criteria.skill: A named instruction surface an agent loads (SKILL.md, doctrine text, checklist).
criteria.agent: A role with a system prompt, tools and an owner; it decides and acts.
criteria.harness: A goal wrapper with stages, gates and a done-test around other assets.
criteria.loop: A repeating cycle with state, an exit condition and a kill switch.
criteria.hook: A deterministic interception at a lifecycle event (pre-tool, stop, session-start).
criteria.workflow: A fixed sequence of typed steps, branches allowed, no autonomous decisions.
criteria.platform_layer: Software that must be built and run: an app, service, registry, database or UI.
criteria.doctrine: A scoring or thinking system: criteria, formulas, scales, gates expressed as rules.
criteria.research_input: A survey, repo index or comparison that informs a build but is not itself buildable.

bms_archetype.instructions: Which BMS archetype family does the work belong in, judged by how much deterministic mechanism the card can actually carry? A1 python-only (deterministic, confidence >= 0.75), A2 hybrid (code with a model in a bounded slot), A3 agent-bounded (agentic with checkpoints), A4 llm-free (open model work, doctrine and novel frames).

criteria.A1_python_only: Deterministic code can carry it end to end: schemas, checks, counters, routing tables, gates.
criteria.A2_hybrid: Code owns the spine, one typed model call inside a bounded slot with a fixed answer set.
criteria.A3_agent_bounded: Needs an agent with checkpoints, tool use and a bounded budget; no fixed answer set.
criteria.A4_llm_free: Open-ended synthesis, doctrine, framing or exploration where a deterministic spine would be a lie.
criteria.other: Cannot be placed on the mode axis.

level.instructions: Altitude of the work on the L1-L7 ladder: L1 direct deterministic repeatable, L2 structured but parameterized, L3 workflow with branches, L4 bounded agentic with checkpoints, L5 mechanism plus tradeoff reasoning, L6 strategic synthesis required, L7 doctrine, exploration or a novel frame.

criteria.other: Spans levels so tightly it cannot be placed.

plane.instructions: Diamond plane the work owns: D1 Physical (operations, assets, devices, infrastructure, payments, scheduling), D2 Cognitive (classification, research, synthesis, reasoning, doctrine, strategy), D3 Nature (feedback loops, cycles, regeneration, resilience, behaviour patterns).

criteria.D1_physical: Operations, assets, logistics, devices, infrastructure, payments, inventory, scheduling.
criteria.D2_cognitive: Classification, research, synthesis, reasoning workflows, doctrine, strategy.
criteria.D3_nature: Feedback loops, cycles, regeneration, resilience, behaviour patterns.
criteria.other: Genuinely spans planes with no primary owner.

buildable_now.instructions: How buildable is this today with the estate that already exists (models, harnesses, registries, data, credentials)? noul high when the parts exist and only assembly is missing; noul low when it depends on unbuilt systems, unknown data or money.

rules.reason: asset kind does not fit the six RIG asset classes - the taxonomy needs a new row, not a guess
not buildable on the current estate: name the missing dependency before scheduling it
A1 means build it as code first - flag so it is not built as an agent by habit
